description: Test categories excluded from the CI step list (scripts/ci/steps.json). Each entry: category, reason, owner (plan), excludedOn, reviewBy (yyyy-MM-dd), status (Excluded | Lifted | Renewed). Every entry is a dated obligation (docs/qa/dated-obligations.json, QA-CI-EXCLUSIONS); CiStepsParityTests rejects a Category!= filter without an Excluded entry here. A renewal never moves a date: the old entry becomes Renewed (with its decision) and a new entry starts.
